svg.aria-label: Product engineering: Requirements, UX and UI, full-stack code, tests and rollout. One owner from ticket to release. AI tooling: Agent pipelines with gated reviews, MCP servers and local models. Models propose, rules decide. Platform: Vercel, Supabase, AWS and Azure on Terraform. CI that blocks a bad merge before review
